description:
Who is married, de facto, separated, divorced, widowed or never married, as counts and shares of adults, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,500 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/marital-status`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_aged_15_plus, married_count, married_pct, separated_count, separated_pct, divorced_count, divorced_pct, widowed_count, widowed_pct, never_married_count, never_married_pct, total_in_private_households_15_plus, partnered_registered_marriage_count, partnered_registered_marriage_pct, partnered_de_facto_count, partnered_de_facto_pct, not_partnered_count, not_partnered_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_area_stats_marital_status
title: LGA · Marital status
